Susumu Kitagawa, Richard Robson, and Omar M. Yaghi shared the 2025 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for developing metal–organic frameworks (MOFs). (nobelprize.org)
MOFs are porous materials made by linking metal ions or clusters with organic molecules. Their tiny pores can be designed to capture specific molecules, making MOFs useful for applications such as capturing carbon dioxide and harvesting water from dry air. (nobelprize.org)
